Package com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest

Class TraceContext.TraceState

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest.TraceContext.TraceState
Enclosing class:
TraceContext
public static final class TraceContext.TraceState extends Object
A parsed, ordered tracestate list of at most 32 key=value members. The left-most member is the most recently mutated. Instances are immutable; with(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) returns a new instance.

Validity

A member key is either a simple key [a-z][a-z0-9_/*-]{0,255} or a multi-tenant key <tenant>@<system>; a value is 1–256 printable characters excluding , and = and not ending in a space. Optional whitespace around members is trimmed and whitespace-only members are ignored. If any member is malformed, or a key repeats, the whole list is dropped (parse(java.lang.String) returns EMPTY) as the spec requires.

      public TraceContext.TraceState with(String key, String value)
      Adds or updates a vendor member and moves it to the front (left-most, i.e. most recent), evicting the oldest (right-most) members to stay within MAX_MEMBERS.
